# Northwestern University

> > Northwestern University is a leading private research university with campuses in Evanston, Illinois, Chicago, and Doha, Qatar, offering global learning opportunities and advancing research in biosciences, social sciences, and the creative arts.

Northwestern is home to the Weinberg College of Arts and Sciences, School of Education and Social Policy (SESP), Bienen School of Music, and numerous research centers including the Simpson Querrey Brain Health Institute. The Global Learning Office (GLO) coordinates study abroad programs and international educational experiences for students worldwide.

## University Overview

- [Northwestern University](https://www.northwestern.edu): Homepage of Northwestern University, a leading private research university
- [About: Northwestern University](https://www.northwestern.edu/about): University overview with mission, campuses in Chicago, Doha, and Qatar
- [History and Traditions: Northwestern University](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/history): University history, campus traditions including Weber Arch and Dillo Day
- [Northwestern's Nobel Laureate](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/nobel-laureate.html): Profile of Joel Mokyr, Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences laureate

## Global Learning and Study Abroad

- [Global Learning Office - Northwestern University](https://www.northwestern.edu/abroad): Global Learning Office homepage for study abroad programs and internships
- [Welcome to GLO!](https://www.northwestern.edu/abroad/northwestern-students): Study abroad guide for Northwestern students to explore programs
- [Applying to Study Abroad](https://www.northwestern.edu/abroad/northwestern-students/applying-to-study-abroad): Application requirements, GPA eligibility, and deadlines for study abroad
- [Program Costs & Financial Aid](https://www.northwestern.edu/abroad/northwestern-students/getting-started/program-costs): Study abroad costs, SAAF fees, financial aid, and scholarship information
- [Identity Abroad](https://www.northwestern.edu/abroad/northwestern-students/getting-started/identity-abroad): Diversity, inclusion, and identity resources for students abroad
- [Student Stories](https://www.northwestern.edu/abroad/northwestern-students/connect-with-students/blogs-highlights): Student blogs and stories from Northwestern Wildcats studying abroad

## Strategic Priorities and Research

- [Advance the biosciences](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/advance-the-biosciences.html): Biosciences research priority featuring synthetic biology and QSIB
- [Foster interdisciplinary innovation among social sciences and global studies](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/social-sciences-global-studies.html): Social sciences priority at Jacobs Center and SESP
- [Enhance the creative and performing arts](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/creative-performing-arts.html): Creative arts priority across Bienen School and School of Communication
- [Deliver an outstanding educational experience for students](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/outstanding-educational-experience.html): Educational excellence priority featuring Searle Center and global programs
- [Invest in our employees](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/investment-employees.html): Employee investment priority covering compensation and professional growth
